non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: The clean-validation-selected 75/25 blend of the 2e-5 and 2.5e-5, 0.0075-smoothing checkpoints reached aggregate test accuracy 0.553943 and macro F1 0.555090, below the 0.0075 single-checkpoint leader. The next controlled encoder-only hypothesis tests whether weight decay 0.02 improves generalization relative to the existing 0.01 and rejected 0.05 settings.
